meta.name: dbt-workflow
meta.description: Load FIRST before any dbt project work. Covers the full 8-step dbt workflow: project scanning, skill loading, validation, macro discovery, research, technical spec, SQL writing, and verification. Also covers output shape inference, incremental model handling, and what to trust in YML.

copy.tagline_en: Run the full dbt project workflow
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use dbt daily for data transformation and modeling

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会按照 8 步工作流处理 dbt 项目：扫描项目、加载辅助技能、解析验证、发现宏、研究数据、写技术规格、写 SQL、验证结果。还会推断输出字段、处理增量模型等。
howto.when: 当你开始处理 dbt 项目（如编写或修改模型）时触发。首次加载该技能后，Claude 会自动执行完整工作流。

say.text: 帮我扫描 dbt 项目目录并启动工作流。
say.note: 触发步骤 1 项目扫描。

say.text: 验证当前 dbt 项目的解析是否通过。
say.note: 触发步骤 3 项目验证。

say.text: 检查这个模型的值是否正确。
say.note: 触发步骤 8 的值验证。

howto.what_en: After loading, Claude follows an 8-step dbt project workflow: project scanning, support skill loading, validation, macro discovery, data research, technical spec writing, SQL writing, and verification. Also handles output shape inference, incremental model logic, etc.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you start working on a dbt project (e.g., writing or modifying models). After initial loading, Claude automatically runs the full workflow when needed.

say_en.text: Scan the dbt project directory and start the workflow.
